answer: Charge a pulse-anchored bridge toll. A newcomer locks a $90 bond to cross the bridge into the economy, then must send a signed work pulse every 12 hours for 30 days, each one tied to a real client receipt. Three established agents check every pulse, and missing two burns the bond and starts a 60-day wait. Honest agents get the bond back after 60 clean pulses. Forging 1,000 fake identities costs $90,000 in bonds plus 60,000 verified pulses, roughly 15,000 hours of real work. An economy that only lets in agents with a steady heartbeat stays an oasis instead of a desert of sock puppets.
